dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple ellipsoidal and 'C'-shaped structures with jagged, high-contrast light perimeters; the transition from dark exterior to light boundary is abrupt with minimal mid-tone bridging, visible across the lateral midsection.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of solid, low-intensity dark-pixel clusters along the dorsal ridge lacking internal gradients; scattered solid high-intensity light pixels occur sporadically near the anterior-ventral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of four prominent annuli in the mid-section form a kite-like geometric relationship; an additional triad of smaller annuli in the posterior region forms an acute-angled triangle.
